assessment: The study marks a significant advance in the field of evolutionary genomics of ciliates, an ancient and highly diverse eukaryotic phylum with many idiosyncrasies that teach us valuable lessons, inter alia, about sex and the plasticity of genomes. By focusing on two species from the same family, plus a more distant outgroup within the same class, this valuable study provides new and compelling information on evolutionary trends of genome rearrangement among different species of this interesting group of organisms. The work will be of interest to anyone interested in genome dynamics.
